en:
Ugh... F-For some reason, my stomach 
feels heavy...

I guess eating tripe hot pot for breakfast
was a bad idea...
<CLT=cltMIND>Should I hang out with Tsumugi for a while?

But Tenko seemed okay. I guess she's the type
to eat stuff like ramen in the morning anyway.

<CLT=cltMIND>I spent some time taking care of
Tsumugi, who didn't look so good...
<CLT=cltMIND>Tsumugi and I grew a little closer today.
